_dict returns its input only when it is a dictionary and otherwise supplies an empty dictionary. This is data-shape normalization, with no distinct product decision shown.

The function finds requirements without references to existing acceptance criteria and creates a reviewable placeholder action for each uncovered requirement. That expresses a rule for addressing acceptance-criteria gaps, not only data conversion or action formatting.

_text strips surrounding whitespace from nonempty strings and returns a default for other inputs. This is input normalization without a distinct product rule.
